visualCharacteristics: Rotating one-slide-at-a-time carousel; each slide pairs a large room-scene image with a content column (eyebrow heading, description, CTA link, product thumbnail, product name, and sale/original price). Prev/next arrows and product-name tab indicators.
contentPattern: One row per slide: room-scene image cell + content cell (heading, description, CTA link, product image, product name link, sale price + original price).
usage: 'Designer Pick' featured-collection carousel on the homepage.
